subject.title: refactor(meeting-bot): extract browser meeting-bot core behind MeetingPlatformAdapter

question: Should `meeting-runtime` become a stable public Plugin SDK subpath now, despite having only the Google Meet adapter as a demonstrated consumer?
rationale: Publishing this barrel creates a large third-party compatibility contract, while repository policy prefers a second consumer before promoting a provider-local extraction into the public SDK.

options.title: Validate before publishing
options.body: Keep the extracted runtime internal until a Teams or other second adapter demonstrates the shared contract and permits the public exports to be narrowed.

options.title: Land with second adapter
options.body: Pair this work with the planned Teams adapter so both consumers and their live proof establish the public contract in one reviewed direction.

options.title: Sponsor the current API
options.body: Explicitly accept the 81-export contract as stable now, subject to refreshed compatibility review and live Google Meet proof.

recommendation.title: Validate before publishing
recommendation.body: Keep the extracted runtime internal until a Teams or other second adapter demonstrates the shared contract and permits the public exports to be narrowed.

likelyOwner.reason: The preceding consolidation history and repository ownership make this person the strongest available decision owner for the meeting-runtime SDK boundary.
